title: Gray-Zone Annexation — Greenland 'Infinite Life' Deal
statement: The US-Denmark-Greenland agreement announced 9/18 is a gray-zone annexation: adversary-exclusion veto + 'permanent control over security, and all other needs' produces functional sovereignty transfer without a declared act. No treaty presentation, no referendum staged; annexation arrives as a stack of instruments each individually deniable. Narrative layer (victory frame, fabricated comparison tables, map kit, GenAI tier) fills the informational vacuum while the text remains unpublished. UNGA signing is the theatrical absorption mechanism.
evidence_confirmed: Trump Truth Social post 9/18 ~1:30 PM ET: 'permanent control over security, and all other needs', no expiration ('Infinite Life'), veto over adversary bases/investments without express written US approval. Corroborated AP/Bloomberg/CNBC/Newsweek within 90 min.

Kit propagation: flag-map image attached minutes after primary; bullet template at figure tier (Benny Johnson 19 min), video montage, meme stacks, GenAI video tier by 9/19 — full ten-tier cycle inside ~24h.
Elected-official tier escalation 9/18-19: Ogles 'OUR hemisphere' framing; victory-reframe meme rewrites January resistance as embarrassing before-state.
Fabricated comparison table (Dilley tier) asserting 'establish installations with or without Denmark's approval' — narrative-repair cycle fired within ~12h of counter-statement.

Denmark/Greenland counter-frame 9/18: parliaments must approve; sovereignty/self-determination language reasserted. Reuters 9/19: tripartite agreement reached, details unpublished, signing expected at UNGA next week.
Counter-frame amplification gap: Map Narratives (7K reactions) out-reaches fact-checking tier by orders of magnitude; 'Canada is next' expansion frame attached by influencer tier.
evidence_contradicted: WaPo: deal 'stops short' of US control; NYT: 1951 agreement already had no time limit, weakening 'Infinite Life' novelty claim.
Danish FM: 'respects the Kingdom's red lines'; Greenland PM: sovereignty/self-determination recognized. Nuuk street sentiment NOT part of victory cycle.
falsifier: Published treaty text contains no authority beyond the 1951 defense structure (presence + mutual defense + base rights, no executive discretion over resources/governance), ratified by both parliaments unchanged, AND the US narrative layer visibly retracts the annexation framing. Breaks if the deal collapses entirely without signing.
forward_watchlist: Published treaty text vs. Dilley fabricated table — row-by-row; any clause granting executive discretion inside Danish jurisdiction.
Parliamentary approval in Copenhagen AND Nuuk — whether either red line holds or is eroded.
Definition of 'no US adversary' — who is excluded, with what enforcement teeth.
Post-signing narrative repair: whether victory frame explains the 'buying it'→'leasing control' reversal without acknowledging it.
'Canada is next' expansion-frame uptake at elected-official tier.
UNGA signing ceremony as premature-victory absorption event.
